# aws-datastores

Posture of the datastores behind an API: DynamoDB PITR and deletion protection, DocDB/Neptune storage encryption, Step Functions logging - each measured from the collect dumps, never inferred.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-STORE-001` | high | DynamoDB table has point-in-time recovery disabled |
| `AF-STORE-002` | medium | DynamoDB table has deletion protection off |
| `AF-STORE-003` | critical | DocumentDB cluster storage is not encrypted |
| `AF-STORE-004` | critical | Neptune cluster storage is not encrypted |
| `AF-STORE-005` | medium | Step Functions state machine has logging OFF |
